mechanism: RoleBinding inventory/inventory-reader-binding has .subjects[0].name set to "inventory-synk" instead of the existing ServiceAccount name "inventory-sync", so Role inventory/inventory-reader (get, list on configmaps) is bound to a nonexistent subject and Deployment inventory/inventory-sync's identity holds no permissions. The worker's API fetch is therefore rejected — "sync fetch error: wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden" — and it logs "serving stale inventory snapshot" while its container stays ready.
